basicDetails.schemeName: Hamaal Hetu Joota, Huk Evan Mahila Hamaal Hetu Soopa Aur Tokari Sahaayata Yojana

children.text: Applicant should be registered in any district of the state.
If applicant received from any other parallel scheme of the State Government, then applicant is not eligible for this scheme.
Beneficiaries aged between 18 years to 60 years will be eligible under the scheme.

eligibilityCriteria.eligibilityDescription_md:
1. Applicant should be registered in any district of the state.
1. If applicant received from any other parallel scheme of the State Government, then applicant is not eligible for this scheme.
1. Beneficiaries aged between 18 years to 60 years will be eligible under the scheme.
